## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The chain torque relation generates the equivalent transverse load. The primary Mechanics of Materials analysis is rear-axle bending: reactions, maximum bending moment, flexural stress, first-yield factor of safety, and equivalent-diameter sizing.
